title: GTA 6 Extended Look Dominates Netflix as Most-Watched Title
description: Rockstar Games' unusual partnership with Netflix paid off massively, with the GTA 6 extended look pulling in 31.1 million views to top the global charts.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Extended Look Dominates Netflix Global Charts

The hype surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster *GTA 6* continues to reach unprecedented heights. According to a recent report by media outlet Push Square, an unusual marketing move by Rockstar to debut an extended look at *GTA 6* exclusively on Netflix has proven to be an overwhelming success.

While the video eventually made its way to YouTube and other public platforms, the subscription streaming service secured a six-hour timed exclusive window. It turns out that strategic window paid off remarkably well for the platform.

## A Massive 31.1 Million Views in Days

Data from Netflix's weekly top 10 charts reveals that the *GTA 6* video was comfortably the most-watched title globally by a significant margin. Between August 27th and August 30th, the video accumulated a staggering **31.1 million views**.

Surpassing traditional television shows, movies, and other streaming originals, the sheer volume of viewers tuning in highlights the cross-media appeal and monumental cultural footprint that the *GTA 6* franchise commands ahead of its eventual release.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's unconventional decision to launch a *GTA 6* video through Netflix demonstrates unmatched marketing confidence. Pulling in 31.1 million views globally in just a matter of days proves that consumer anticipation for the game is operating on a completely different level compared to any other entertainment property today.
